baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence جَاءَكَ يَسْعَى joins arrival at the addressee to an imperfect verb of purposeful motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pronominal endpoint in جَاءَكَ makes the addressee the destination, while سعى supplies directed exertion. The person is therefore an intentional seeker whose movement is itself part of the claim on attention, not a merely present bystander.

activation_trace.role: Concrete arrival supplies the completed approach to the addressed person and establishes the encounter's endpoint.
Purposeful brisk movement turns that arrival into an intentional pursuit rather than accidental proximity.

changed_reading.before: A person happens to come while moving quickly.
changed_reading.after: A person deliberately makes the addressee his destination and expends effort to reach the encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَاءَكَ and يَسْعَى can be heard as an arrival that presents not only a body but an active undertaking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The bringing branch of جاء and the work-and-earning branch of سعى combine into an arrival bearing exertion, readiness, or a claim produced by effort. The syntax does not state an object, so this is an activated relational image rather than an assertion of ellipsis.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something makes the arrival capable of carrying the seeker's exertion into the encounter.
Work, earning, and active endeavor supply the non-material thing figuratively presented by the arrival.

changed_reading.before: The visitor arrives in haste to receive something.
changed_reading.after: The seeker arrives already bearing work, readiness, and invested effort that ask to be received.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired motion verbs جَاءَكَ يَسْعَى permit two supplied rivalry branches to converge on access to the addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated-coming competition and rivalry in striving make the approach legible as a bid to prevail in reaching a scarce audience. Both images are idiomatically more distant than ordinary arrival and purposeful motion, but their convergence creates a coherent social mechanism worth retaining.

activation_trace.role: Competition through repeated coming recasts arrival as persistence within a struggle for access.
Rivaling and prevailing in effort supplies the competitive pressure governing that bid for access.

changed_reading.before: The seeker simply hastens toward the addressee.
changed_reading.after: The seeker persists into an unequal contest for access, trying to make earnest need reach a scarce hearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contraction and turning-away frame a social inversion: active attention is presented to the person displaying self-sufficiency, while the person who spends effort to approach is displaced by another preoccupation. The focus arrival thus becomes a contest whose burden is allocated inversely to need.

activation_trace.role: Repeated-coming rivalry makes the focus arrival a persistent bid for access rather than neutral entrance.
Rivalry in striving supplies the pressure of competing claims on the addressee's limited attention.
Facial contraction from distress or anger gives the access decision a visible affective surface.
Turning away supplies the directional rejection against which the seeker's approach is measured.
Displayed self-sufficiency identifies the low-need party who nevertheless receives prioritized attention.
Actively presenting oneself toward something supplies the attention invested in the self-sufficient party.
Being occupied away from one thing by another names the diversion that defeats the seeker's bid for access.

structural_cues: The أما...أما contrast distributes two people across 80:5 and 80:8 while the addressee's orientation moves in opposite directions.
The focus person's two motion verbs are set against the addressee's prior turning and subsequent distraction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach, self-sufficiency, active attention, and diversion; I infer an attention-allocation mechanism in which the needier party bears more pursuit cost. A live alternative is a one-time correction of priorities without a general competition model.

changed_reading.before: The seeker is one visitor among others who happens to arrive at a busy moment.
changed_reading.after: The seeker exposes an inverted economy of attention: earnest need must compete, while apparent independence attracts pursuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding arrival identifies the focus seeker as a person without sight. Purposeful motion toward the addressee now includes navigation performed without visual access, so the seeker bears both the physical work of reaching the encounter and the social risk of not being received.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful brisk movement supplies the focus person's active traversal toward the addressee.
The preceding occurrence of concrete arrival links the focus approach to the person introduced before it.
Loss of sight adds an accessibility constraint to the purposeful movement named in the focus.

structural_cues: 80:2 immediately precedes the focus contrast and supplies the arrived person's visual condition.
The repeated root ج ي ء binds the earlier introduction to the focus restatement before later analogies are considered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual arrival, absent sight, and purposeful motion; I infer that reaching the addressee requires additional navigation labor and heightens the asymmetry of reception. Alternatively, يسعى may foreground earnest endeavor more than literal locomotion.

changed_reading.before: A generic motivated person deliberately approaches.
changed_reading.after: A seeker without sight personally absorbs the navigation cost of reaching the addressee, making any failure of reception more asymmetrical.

context_deltas.mechanism: Growth and purification, reminder, benefit, and reverent fear give the striving a possible inner yield. The seeker's motion is therefore simultaneously bodily and transformative: an effort to enter a process in which recollection can produce beneficial change.

activation_trace.role: Active work and endeavor widen the focus verb from locomotion to intentional participation in change.
Growth and increase supply one prospective yield toward which the seeker's effort can be directed.
Purification and rectification supply a coexisting inward account of that prospective change.
A reminder that causes recollection provides the operative medium through which the effort may transform the seeker.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the practical effect that distinguishes fruitful reception from mere contact.
Fear joined with awe supplies the inward orientation accompanying the outward striving.

structural_cues: The possible outcomes in 80:3-4 precede the focus restatement, while 80:9 follows it with the seeker's inward orientation.
The uncertainty marker in 80:3 keeps transformation possible rather than guaranteed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possible growth, purification, reminder, benefit, and awe; I assign these as the sought yield of سعى. They may instead characterize disposition and possible result separately while the focus verb remains chiefly physical haste.

changed_reading.before: The seeker moves quickly to obtain information.
changed_reading.after: The seeker works toward an uncertain but live transformation in which reminder may become growth, purification, and benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is associated with written sheets, hands that convey, and emissarial mediation that removes estrangement. Against that chain, the seeker's arrival is not an interruption from outside but reciprocal motion at the receiving end of a relay: transmission moves toward people, and this person moves toward transmission.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something lets the focus arrival participate in a two-way transmission rather than bare entrance.
Active endeavor supplies the recipient-side labor needed to complete the relay.
The reminder as an instrument of recollection identifies what the transmission is meant to activate.
The written sheet supplies a durable carrier in the relay between reminder and recipient.
The hand as an organ of passing and receiving supplies the relay's concrete transfer function.
An emissary who removes estrangement supplies mediation across the distance the seeker is crossing.

structural_cues: 80:11-16 expands from reminder to sheets, hands, and mediating figures after the encounter scene.
The focus has two approach verbs, allowing recipient motion to answer the later sequence of message transmission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, writing, hands, and mediation; I connect them into a transmission chain and place the seeker's exertion at its recipient end. A live alternative is that the later sequence marks the reminder's dignity without describing a relay into this encounter.

changed_reading.before: The seeker intrudes upon a delivery already in progress.
changed_reading.after: The seeker's approach is the recipient's reciprocal leg of delivery, completing rather than interrupting the reminder's movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measure and planning, an extended path, ease after difficulty, and an obligation not yet discharged reframe striving as accountable uptake of enabled conditions. The seeker acts vigorously, but the route and its possibility precede his work; effort is response rather than self-originating merit.

activation_trace.role: Work and active conduct supply the seeker's accountable response within the larger sequence.
Ordering through measure and deliberation supplies conditions established before the seeker's own endeavor.
An extended traversable way supplies the route on which the focus striving can be situated.
Opening into ease after difficulty makes movement possible without erasing the seeker's exertion.
Discharging and fulfilling a due supplies the completion criterion against which active striving is judged.
Binding request supplies the obligation whose fulfillment gives endeavor accountable direction.

structural_cues: 80:19-23 orders measure, eased path, death, renewed life, and unfinished obligation as a temporal sequence.
The focus imperfect verb can remain ongoing inside that broader sequence rather than denote one completed trip.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior ordering, a traversable eased path, and an unmet command; I infer that the focus effort is responsive agency within enabled conditions. Alternatively, the later sequence may concern generic humanity without retrospectively specifying this seeker's motion.

changed_reading.before: The seeker's effort is an isolated achievement generated by personal urgency.
changed_reading.after: The seeker actively takes up an already measured and opened route, making effort a responsible answer to enablement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch images a hollow where water gathers, while the later material sequence pours water, opens ground, and brings forth seed-growth. Read analogically, arrival gathers potential at a receptive site and striving is germinal labor; attention is not a scarce prize but the opened ground needed for effort to become growth.

activation_trace.role: A low place where water gathers supplies the surprising receptive-site image attached to the focus arrival.
Work and active endeavor supply the germinal labor whose yield depends on reception.
Pouring and downward flow provide the input that can gather at the focus branch's receptive site.
Conveying water by pouring supplies the directed transfer from provision to receptive ground.
Splitting and opening supply the receptive transformation required before hidden potential can emerge.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the visible yield of provision meeting opened ground.
The seed that sprouts supplies a compact material analogue for the seeker's latent capacity.

structural_cues: 80:25-27 forms a causal sequence of flow, opening, and emergence, reinforced by repeated verbal nouns.
The focus itself orders arrival before ongoing endeavor, permitting a site-then-growth analogy without replacing the human referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a water-gathering focus branch and a later flow-opening-growth chain; I map reception to ground and the seeker's effort to seed potential. This is a reader-built material analogy, and the live alternative is that the provision sequence remains independent of the encounter.

changed_reading.before: The arriving seeker competes for a fixed quantity of attention.
changed_reading.after: The arriving seeker carries latent growth whose emergence depends on whether the encounter becomes receptive, opened ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same arrival root returns for a later event that is followed by flight. This reverses the focus geometry: now a vulnerable person voluntarily comes toward the addressee, whereas later an unavoidable arrival comes toward everyone and people flee even their closest relations. Present reception becomes a temporal opportunity before approach turns into inescapable pursuit.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary arrival supplies the present movement of a person toward the addressee.
Purposeful movement marks the present approach as voluntary and directed.
The repeated arrival image creates the later incoming pole that reverses the focus direction.
Compulsion within the arrival family sharpens the later event as an approach that cannot be declined.
Flight supplies the reversed human motion away from the later arrival and away from close relations.

structural_cues: 80:33 pairs the later arrival with ص خ خ, which lacks a branch inventory and is used here only as the packet's structural label for the overwhelming event.
The repeated ج ي ء links a person coming toward the addressee in 80:8 to an event coming before human flight in 80:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two arrivals and later flight; I infer a temporal and ethical inversion in which present voluntary approach is a receivable opportunity before unavoidable approach. The live alternative is a lexical echo between separate scenes without this warning function.

changed_reading.before: The focus records only a visitor's present approach.
changed_reading.after: The visitor's voluntary approach is the receivable inverse of a future arrival from which people will flee, making present attention temporally charged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the supplied non-dominant mapping for س ع ي activates neglect and loose wandering rather than goal-directed effort. It remains packet-valid and anchored at يَسْعَى through the explicit split mapping, and context distraction gives the counterpressure a social mechanism. Downstream prose must call it a form-distant coexistence with, not a replacement for, the dominant purposeful-motion branch.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The single focus word يَسْعَى carries both the dominant purposeful-motion inventory and a non-dominant split inventory of being left to wander loose.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful movement supplies the seeker's own directed agency in the dominant mapping.
Neglect and wandering loose supply a non-dominant counterimage of motion occurring without custodial direction.
Diversion from one person by another turns the split-root counterimage into socially produced neglect.

changed_reading.before: The seeker's motion is unambiguously purposeful and adequately guided by the encounter.
changed_reading.after: The seeker advances purposefully while being left socially loose: self-direction compensates for attention that has failed to guide or receive him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it compresses the opening facial contraction and the later divergent faces into a diagnostic frame around a focus verse that names no face. It remains anchored in the seeker's directed arrival as the encounter that exerts diagnostic pressure. Render it only as a structural surface analogy; the packet does not establish that this single reception causally produces the final face states.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَاءَكَ يَسْعَى creates a face-to-face destination even though the focus names motion rather than facial expression.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at the addressee supplies the interpersonal encounter whose reception can become visible.
A contracted face supplies the immediate visible registration of resistance at the encounter's opening.
The face as forward-facing surface supplies the later field on which orientation becomes public.
A face becoming unveiled and bright supplies one outcome image of disclosed orientation.
Dust-colored covering supplies the opposed outcome in which the visible surface is obscured.
Overwhelming and mastering supplies the pressure that overtakes the opposed face state.

changed_reading.before: The seeker merely arrives before an addressee whose reaction is incidental.
changed_reading.after: The seeker's approach becomes diagnostic pressure: reception begins on a contracted face and is later echoed by faces whose orientation is openly revealed or covered.

strongest_changes: The preceding blindness cue turns ordinary purposeful motion into accessibility labor borne by the seeker.
Growth, purification, reminder, benefit, and awe turn physical haste into an effort toward uncertain inner transformation.
The contrast with self-sufficiency and diverted attention reframes arrival as an unequal contest for access.
The repeated arrival root and later flight reverse the focus geometry, making present reception an opportunity before unavoidable approach.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's doubled motion supports several live mechanisms at once: directed approach, presentation of invested work, and competition for access. The split mapping for س ع ي adds a deliberately contained counterreading of purposeful motion under neglect, while later transmission, cultivation, and arrival sequences activate relay, growth, and reversal models without collapsing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يَسْعَى foregrounds literal brisk movement, broader active endeavor, or both in equal measure.
How much weight the objectless syntax can bear from the bringing and presentation branch of ج ي ء.
Whether the competition branches identify a real attention mechanism or remain an idiomatically distant resonance.
Whether the cultivation and face-surface models are structural activations or only cross-domain analogies.
How strongly the non-dominant س و ع mapping should press against the dominant purposeful-motion reading.
